admission.justification: A row the refresh never selected was never asked about the candidate tree, so a leaf published a row citing a deleted file; the deleted-only case proves the whole catalog is asked.

applicability: Every entity row of a converted leaf's catalog, whether or not the refresh would recompute it.
conditions: The code candidate tree's path set is read once and each row's evidence paths are checked against it.
exclusions: An unreadable candidate tree, which raises naming the step, the tree and the repository.

evidence: role-reports/worker/a17f4d83-52c9-4b06-9e14-7d38b05ac621/role-launch/evidence/L176-A2-pass-after-12-tests.txt: the deleted-only case asserts the row is outside the plan's required and unsupported lists, is refused by the preview and the apply with both HEADs unchanged, and lands once re-pointed at a retained file with the independently computed value

statement: Every entity row of the catalog is evidence-checked against the code candidate tree whether or not the refresh would recompute it, so a leaf that deletes the only file a row cites is refused before the code commit.
